payload.title: The metric writer stores an unbounded sample-to-write delay in the 32-bit ingestion_latency_ms column, so a reading sampled more than about 24.8 days before it is written fails its INSERT and takes the rest of its batch with it
evidence: apps/sensor-service/src/ingestion/__tests__/sensor-ingestion-paths.rls.postgres.spec.ts:189 (fixed 2026-10-06 sample times; red since 2026-10-31 06:30Z: value out of range for type integer)
payload.rule_violated: A value written to a column fits the column's type; one row's value does not fail the rest of its batch
payload.notes: Found while running the sensor-service suite for the ADR-047 simulator move; red on main from about 06:30Z on 2026-10-31 for every PR that affects sensor-service.
